# Perform Levene's test for equality of variances

<small>Source: [`man/performLeveneTest.Rd`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/man/performLeveneTest.Rd) · Help: `?performLeveneTest`</small>

Tests equality of variances across groups using residuals from a linear model.

## Usage

```r
performLeveneTest(model, data = NULL, group)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   an object of class `lm`.

`data`
:   data frame used to fit `model`. When `NULL`, the default, the model frame of `model` is used, so `group` must then be a variable of the model. The model frame holds the terms of the model rather than its variables (`log(x)` rather than `x`), so a model that transforms a variable needs `data`, as does a model with an `offset()` term.

`group`
:   name of the grouping variable.

## Value

An object of class `htest` containing the F statistic, p-value and degrees of freedom.

## Details

Absolute deviations from group means are analyzed via a one-way ANOVA. The resulting \(F\) statistic has \(k-1\) and \(N-k\) degrees of freedom under the null of equal variances.

## Supported models

It accepts an `lm` and a `glm` with the Gaussian family and the identity link, unweighted
or with positive weights, a `fitWLS()` fit and, since 0.16.0, a rank-deficient fit, which it
tests on the estimable part of its design: it gives the value of the same model fitted without the
aliased columns. It refuses a `glm` of another family or link, a `survey::svyglm()` fit, a
fit with a zero weight, a coefficient that is not finite for another reason, and `data` that
lack rows or variables of the fit. Which model each test accepts, and why, is set out in
[`test_results`](test_results.md), under *Supported models*.

## References

Levene, H. (1960). Robust tests for equality of variances. In *Contributions to Probability and Statistics* (pp. 278–292). Stanford University Press.

Brown, M. B., & Forsythe, A. B. (1974). Robust tests for the equality of variances. *Journal of the American Statistical Association*, 69(346), 364–367. [doi:10.1080/01621459.1974.10482955](https://doi.org/10.1080/01621459.1974.10482955)

## Examples

```r
 data(mtcars)
 mtcars$cyl <- factor(mtcars$cyl)
 m <- lm(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars)
 performLeveneTest(m, mtcars, "cyl")
```
